get_inside.text: Baxtorian Falls
Entrance in the waterfall.

The dungeon is in northern Kandarin, and is entered through an outcrop on the face of the Baxtorian Falls. To enter the dungeon the player must have Glarial's amulet and a rope. Go through Almera's house near the falls and out the back gate, use the log raft there to float to an island in the river. From there, get to the next island by using the rope on the rock there. On the second island, use the rope on the dead tree and lower yourself to the ledge on the falls. With Glarial's amulet equipped or in your inventory, enter the dungeon.
pic: A player swimming to the 2nd island with the aid of a rope.

get_inside.text: The quickest teleport to the area is by teleporting with the games necklace or lunar spell Barbarian Teleport to the Barbarian Outpost, which is directly to the north of Almera's house. Another option, requiring the completion of The Grand Tree and 37 Agility, is to take the Spirit Tree to the Tree Gnome Stronghold and go north, northeast past the Grand Tree, down the tree shortcut and past the lake. Alternatively the player can run north-west from the Ardougne lodestone, past the Fishing Guild and up the fenced mountain path to Almera's house.
Player can also use the fairy ring code BJQ to enter the Ancient Caverns and use the log there to travel to the foot of the falls, close to Almera's house.
The Dungeoneering cape can teleport the user directly to the entrance of the Baxtorian Falls resource dungeon, found in the centre-north room of the dungeon.

Players with 24 Construction may build a rope rack, providing unlimited coils of rope, next to the raft that leads to the Waterfall Dungeon. This requires a saw and hammer (tool-belt tools will suffice), five coils of rope and three oak planks. Alternatively, if the player has allocated 50 points into the pet track at May's Quest Caravan, Lorehound pet can be summoned, providing a free rope.

Note: Do not attempt to swim across or climb down the tree without a rope, as this will fail and you will be washed quite a way down the river and dealt some damage. This also applies when attempting to enter the cavern without having the amulet (not required to wear).

A barrel is located next to the dungeon's entrance, allowing the players to leave the area, leaving them near Gerald, in the same spot as being washed out, but without taking damage. It was originally necessary if the players did not have access to any means of teleporting out, however due to the large number of currently available teleport options this method of leaving dungeon is largely obsolete.

place.title: Waterfall Dungeon
place.summary: During the Waterfall Quest the dungeon is accessed in search of the Chalice of Eternity, containing the treasure of the elven king Baxtorian. During the Roving Elves quest the dungeon must be entered again to consecrate the resting place of queen Glarial. During The Light Within it is discovered that Baxtorian changed himself into a crystal statue and that the statue of Glarial, his wife, contained the Seren shard of integrity.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The dungeon is in northern Kandarin, and is entered through an outcrop on the face of the Baxtorian Falls. To enter the dungeon the player must have Glarial's amulet and a rope. Go through Almera's house near the falls and out the back gate, use the log raft there to float to an island in the river. From there, get to the next island by using the rope on the rock there. On the second island, use the rope on the dead tree and lower yourself to the ledge on the falls. With Glarial's amulet equipped or in your inventory, enter the dungeon.

The quickest teleport to the area is by teleporting with the games necklace or lunar spell Barbarian Teleport to the Barbarian Outpost, which is directly to the north of Almera's house. Another option, requiring the completion of The Grand Tree and 37 Agility, is to take the Spirit Tree to the Tree Gnome Stronghold and go north, northeast past the Grand Tree, down the tree shortcut and past the lake. Alternatively the player can run north-west from the Ardougne lodestone, past the Fishing Guild and up the fenced mountain path to Almera's house.

Player can also use the fairy ring code BJQ to enter the Ancient Caverns and use the log there to travel to the foot of the falls, close to Almera's house.

The whirlpool entrance to the Ancient Cavern is south of the Barbarian Outpost, at the head of the River Dougne, above Baxtorian Falls. Players can get there by walking west from Seers' Village, north from East Ardougne, or east from the Tree Gnome Stronghold. (From the Stronghold, players with level 37 Agility can take the shortcut northeast of the Grand Tree; otherwise, the more round-about route through the Stronghold's southern gate is necessary.)
Some teleports can be used to get near the whirlpool:
A games necklace can teleport to the Barbarian Outpost. This is quickest way to get to the whirlpool, as it is just south of the Outpost.
A combat bracelet can teleport to the Ranging Guild, which is east of Baxtorian Falls.
Barbarian Teleport from the Lunar Spellbook. Teleporting between the Barbarian Outpost and Lunar Isle provides quick banking during slayer tasks.
A plain of mud sphere can teleport one near the Fishing Guild, which is south-east of Baxtorian Falls.
A skills necklace can teleport to the Fishing Guild, which is south-east of Baxtorian Falls.
Players with level 37 Agility can use the gnome gliders or spirit trees to travel to the Tree Gnome Stronghold and then use the shortcut north of the Grand Tree to get to the Baxtorian Falls lake.
Three teleports can be used to directly enter the dungeon:
Fairy ring code BJQ, which will teleport near the north-western most waterfiends, once it is repaired as described earlier.

The ferocious ring, which is a drop from the creatures in Kuradal's Dungeon, can teleport the player to Kuradal (Note: you can only attack the monsters in the dungeon if they are your current Slayer assignment assigned by Kuradal, Morvran, or Laniakea.)
The Slayer cape can be used to teleport the player to Kuradal.

get_inside.text: Southeast of the Rellekka Hunter area

The Brine Rat Cavern is in the north-eastern region of the Fremennik Province. There are multiple ways to travel to the cavern. One of the quickest ways is to use the fairy ring, code DKS. Alternatively, a player may use the Fremennik Province lodestone and run northeast. Mask or helm of the Frozen Wyrm twice a day to teleport into the Ice strykewyrm cave. From there, exit the cave and you will emerge close to the windswept tree.

place.title: Brine Rat Cavern
place.summary: The Brine Rat Cavern is a series of caverns which feature heavily in Olaf's Quest, and cannot be accessed beforehand. It can be entered after starting the quest by digging deep snow south of the windswept tree. The entrance is located on a plateau east of Olaf Hradson and southeast of the Rellekka Hunter area. After digging the deep snow, the player will be stunned for a few seconds and emerge in the southwestern section of the cavern.

place.title: Ancient Cavern

getting_there.heading: Location and getting there
getting_there.text:
The whirlpool entrance to the Ancient Cavern is south of the Barbarian Outpost, at the head of the River Dougne, above Baxtorian Falls. Players can get there by walking west from Seers' Village, north from East Ardougne, or east from the Tree Gnome Stronghold. (From the Stronghold, players with level 37 Agility can take the shortcut northeast of the Grand Tree; otherwise, the more round-about route through the Stronghold's southern gate is necessary.)

Some teleports can be used to get near the whirlpool:
• A games necklace can teleport to the Barbarian Outpost. This is quickest way to get to the whirlpool, as it is just south of the Outpost.
• A combat bracelet can teleport to the Ranging Guild, which is east of Baxtorian Falls.
• Barbarian Teleport from the Lunar Spellbook. Teleporting between the Barbarian Outpost and Lunar Isle provides quick banking during slayer tasks.
• A plain of mud sphere can teleport one near the Fishing Guild, which is south-east of Baxtorian Falls.
• A skills necklace can teleport to the Fishing Guild, which is south-east of Baxtorian Falls.
• Players with level 37 Agility can use the gnome gliders or spirit trees to travel to the Tree Gnome Stronghold and then use the shortcut north of the Grand Tree to get to the Baxtorian Falls lake.

Three teleports can be used to directly enter the dungeon:
• Fairy ring code BJQ, which will teleport near the north-western most waterfiends, once it is repaired as described earlier.
• The ferocious ring, which is a drop from the creatures in Kuradal's Dungeon, can teleport the player to Kuradal (Note: you can only attack the monsters in the dungeon if they are your current Slayer assignment assigned by Kuradal, Morvran, or Laniakea.)
• The Slayer cape can be used to teleport the player to Kuradal.

It was previously possible for players to be trapped inside the maze if they did not have a slash weapon to cut webs, but having the tool belt with a knife will always allow you to cut through webs, even without a slash weapon or knife in your inventory.

As each one appears, there will be voice-acted dialogue between Sliske and Guthix in how Guthix tells Sliske of what his fate is and how Guthix must die by Sliske's hands alone.

map: leagueRegion: Desert

The Kharidian Desert is an expansive region located south of the nations of Misthalin and Morytania. It spans from the city of Al Kharid in the north to Menaphos and Sophanem in the south. Al Kharid is accessible by all players alike, but the desert south of the Shantay Pass is restricted to members only. In addition, the desert becomes a dangerous region south of the pass, requiring players to carry waterskins or other water sources, lest they suffer the effects of desert heat.

place.title: Freneskae
place.summary: Once considered a "perfect" world, Freneskae is now a dark wasteland. Its toxic atmosphere is riddled with constant lightning storms, volcanic eruptions and lava flows near its surface of bare rock. Its native life struggles to survive in the harsh climate, and as a result it is a world of constant warfare. In addition to the Mahjarrat, Freneskae was home to the Mahserrat, Mahkorat, and the Chelon-Mah, and is the only world on which muspah and nihil may be found.

It later returns as Smoulders, the Revenger in The Zamorakian Undercity Elite Dungeon.

get_inside.text: The entrance to the dungeon is located east of the pulley, which is used to enter Senntisten behind the Ancient door just north of the Archaeology Guild.
Use the boss portal in War's Retreat.
Use the boss portal in the Max Guild (requires 99 in every skill).
Use the Pontifex Shadow Ring, restored after the City of Senntisten quest, to teleport to Senntisten, run north to the Pulley.

Use the Archaeology journal to teleport to the Archaeology Guild, then walk north to the ancient door (dungeon), east to the ancient doors (The Empty Throne Room) or north-east to a winch (Senntisten Temple).
Using a gnome glider to fly to Lemanto Andra (3) leaves the player very close to the ancient door.

The dig sites map in the Archaeology Guild, archaeology teleport or the master archaeologist's outfit can be used to teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site camp just north-east of the cathedral, provided the player has level 60 Archaeology or access to those items.
Dig site pendant can be used to teleport to the following:
Varrock Dig Site - Archaeologist's workbench & Bank chest, walk north-west to the ancient door.
Senntisten Temple - north-west winch entrance to temple.
Skeletal horror Teleport or invitation box can be used to teleport to the north-east of the ancient door.
Teleport to Earth altar, or using Fort Forinthry Teleport to the north-west of the ancient door.
Ride the balloon to Varrock to the north-west of the ancient door.

Use the Ring of kinship to teleport to Daemonheim, and then run east to the treasure chest. Use the teleport on the chest and select The Zamorakian Undercity (requires completion of Impressing the Locals).
Use the teleport on the treasure chest outside Temple of Aminishi, The Shadow Reef, or the Dragonkin Laboratory (requires completion of Impressing the Locals).

place.title: The Zamorakian Undercity
place.summary: While it is considered an Elite Dungeon (with its own luck charms and ability to teleport to the other Elite Dungeons) it is noticeably different compared to the previous three; the health of enemies scales to the party size (and are also more dangerous) and its luck charm costs slightly more and cannot be converted. It also possesses an enrage system that goes up in intervals of 100% past 4,000% enrage, and the enemies' strengths, types, and quantities begin to change as it increases, capping at 60,000%. Players are free to choose their enrage from 0 to 4,000%. Clearing the undercity increases the rewards obtained from Zamorak.

get_inside.text: Teleport to there by fairy ring code BLQ.

place.title: Yu'biusk
place.summary: At some point, Yu'biusk was discovered by the god Bandos, who, after seeing the people of the world as savages, decided to give them civilisation as he knew it, and declare the world as his. During the God Wars, Bandos brought the various Yu'biuskian races to Gielinor to fight for and bring glory to his name. Following Bandos' banishment from Gielinor he took his anger out on the Yu'biuskian tribes. Some of these tribes he would manipulate and deceive while others just took advantage of weakened tribes and attacked them. Eventually this led to the construction of fire-raining weapons - weapons the likes no other world has seen according to Bandos. These weapons were what eventually tore Yu'biusk asunder and made it what it is today.

get_inside.text: Unquiet Ocean
There are many ways to travel to, from, and within Karamja.
Ship

A popular way to travel for free players is by ship from Port Sarim by talking to the men in front of the ship (first ship you come across heading east from the Port Sarim Lodestone), which costs 30gp for the trip. This can be reduced to 15gp, if you're a member, by completing the easy Karamja achievements, and completely free by using the Ring of charos(a). Another ship route is available from the Ardougne Docks to Brimhaven. Players who wish to travel by boat will have their inventories searched by customs officers, as the law prohibits individuals from carrying rum off the island. Those who wish to circumvent this and smuggle rum to the mainland may find it helpful to check the guide for the Pirate's Treasure quest, where the player must smuggle Karamja rum.

When travelling from Shilo Village, players should stand north of the bush just south-west of the city and then cut two bushes to enter the jungle.
The fairy ring CJS can be used to teleport to the area. It must first be restored with 5 bittercap mushrooms before travelling to or from it.

A juju teleport spiritbag or witchdoctor mask can teleport the player to the nearby Herblore Habitat. The player can then reach the jungle by climbing over the vine to the north, heading west along the river, and hacking through the dense jungle to the south.

Casting the Western Kharazi Jungle Teleport while on the Lunar spellbook will teleport you to the western side of the Kharazi jungle, a short distance west of the small pool located in the center & south-west of the village past the dense forests. This spell requires level 81 Magic and 3 astral runes, 2 law runes and 1 time rune to cast.

place.title: Yu'biusk
place.summary: At some point, Yu'biusk was discovered by the god Bandos, who, after seeing the people of the world as savages, decided to give them civilisation as he knew it, and declare the world as his. During the God Wars, Bandos brought the various Yu'biuskian races to Gielinor to fight for and bring glory to his name. Following Bandos' banishment from Gielinor he took his anger out on the Yu'biuskian tribes. Some of these tribes he would manipulate and deceive while others just took advantage of weakened tribes and attacked them. Eventually this led to the construction of fire-raining weapons - weapons the likes no other world has seen according to Bandos. These weapons were what eventually tore Yu'biusk asunder and made it what it is today.

get_inside.text: Morytania

Canifis may be accessed after completing the Priest in Peril quest or defeating the ghoul and passing through the holy barrier in the basement of Paterdomus for the first time. After doing so, players may travel to Canifis through any of the following methods:
Canifis lodestone just north-east of Canifis.
The Ancient Magicks spell Kharyrll Teleport.
Focussing one of the portals in the Portal Chamber of their house to Canifis (Kharyrll).
Fairy Ring code CKS.

After completing Ghosts Ahoy, using the ectophial to teleport to the ectofuntus. This gives a moderately-close teleport that is free and unlimited. If lost, one may obtain a replacement from Velorina.
After completing In Search of the Myreque, taking the shortcut to Mort'ton down a ladder south of the Hair of the Dog inn that leads to the north-east part of the Mort Myre Swamp.
Taking the Swamp Boat between The Hollows and Mort'ton. This cuts out around half the distance.
Using a ring of slaying to teleport to the Slayer Tower just north-west of Canifis.

get_inside.text: Western Sea

pic: The standstone south of Poison Waste

get_inside.text: Before repairing fairy ring BJS (requires five bittercap mushrooms), players can get to the Lost Grove by inspecting the standstone south of the Poison Waste, west of the incandescent wisp colony. Methods for getting there include:
Use the incandescent wisp colony teleport on the elder divination outfit or the Solak boss portal.
Create a group for fighting Solak, Guardian of the Grove and teleport there alone (the minimum player requirement is only one).
Use the fairy ring code BKP or a ring of duelling to go south of Castle Wars and run west.
Use the Northern Lost Grove Teleport or its tablet.

The magic golem head can teleport to the Lost Grove (near the vinecrawlers) if a Shooting Star lands there, once per day. Oddly, it can return the error message "You do not meet the requirements to teleport to where the shooting star has landed." despite there being no requirements to enter The Lost Grove, and the magic golem head may still be able to teleport to there regardless.
Once arriving at the Lost Grove, players may use five bittercap mushrooms on the fairy ring near the middle of the island and then use the code BJS to get there even faster in the future.

place.title: Wilderness
place.summary: The Wilderness is infamous for being arguably the most perilous area in all of Gielinor. The terrain is mostly charred and barren, gradually progressing from sparsely wooded areas to volcanic terrain to a frozen wasteland as the player travels north. The Wilderness is inhabited by many different foes that generally become stronger in the deeper areas, including thugs, zombies, grizzly bears, and hill giants, as well as more powerful creatures such as demons, dragons, dark beasts, and glacors. Most of the monsters in the Wilderness are permanently aggressive, can attack in groups and follow players quite far from their habitat, so caution should be taken when running past groups of dangerous monsters. The main appeal of the Wilderness is that it offers many lucrative combat and skilling opportunities, albeit with greater risk of death.

ml.name: Daemonheim
ml.text: Soulgazers are Slayer monsters and a type of stalker found in Daemonheim that can only be fought while Dungeoneering. Its combat level is 128 and it requires level 99 Slayer to damage. It attacks all players within reach at once with an accurate, magic based yellow orb attack with a max hit of 368. Magic damage can be reduced by using Protect from Magic or Deflect Magic. The much sought after hexhunter bow is only obtainable as a drop from a soulgazer.

get_inside.text: Between Tirannwn and Kandarin
The entrance to the Underground Pass
pic: The entrance to the Underground Pass

get_inside.text: The following only contains information on how to get through the pass after the quest is done.
pic: A pit full of spikes within the Underground Pass

get_inside.text: The player will not be able to enter Iban's Temple and the elven lands until the player has spoken to King Lathas at the start of Regicide. The player's quest journal will mention about assassinating his brother if they have talked to him.
Travelling through Underground path
To go through the path, it is recommended to have a high Agility level. A Thieving level of 50 is another advantage.
These items are needed:
A rope (bring more if the Agility level is low)
A shortbow (chargebow will not work)
A few of bronze, iron, steel, mithril, adamant, rune, dragon, or dark arrows (bring a few extras should you do so; no advantage in type)
Food to survive traps and monsters
Part 1
Checklist | * Enter the pass through the cave entrance in West Ardougne.
Simply walk around the swamp and do not attempt to cross the bubbles in the cave.
Talk to Koftik, and he will give you a damp cloth.
Use it on an arrow to change it to a fire arrow.

Light this arrow. It is possible to miss arrows in the next steps, so you may need to make more. Only make one at a time because you can not light these arrows if there is more than one in your inventory.
Go to the north.
Equip the bow and fire at the guide rope with the lit fire arrow, and you will automatically cross the bridge.
Once you have crossed the bridge, you may be attacked by level 42 blessed spiders if you are under level #expr:42*2 Combat. Stay away from the small rooms to the north and south to avoid them.
Now, go to the little chamber to the north and pick up a plank.
Continue going south, then east.

Use a rope on an old spike on the ground on your side next to the north gap. It is possible to fail this part and lose your rope, so bringing multiple ropes is a good precaution. If you do fall, you will have to navigate a rock maze to get out. You will end up at the beginning of the pass, and you'll have to start with firing at the guide rope again. The old spike is very small and slightly below ground level. It may be necessary to point your camera west and zoom very far in to see it.
Continue following the path and climb over two rockslides.

You will come to a grid of spike traps. For each person the path to cross these is different, so it is suggested that once you find your path, you write it down somewhere. You could already have figured out which path is safe for you while doing the quest Underground Pass. The area prevents you from using abilities like Surge.
Pathmap | 5 | 5 | id=Underground Pass
Once past the spike traps, pull the [[Lever (Underground path, portcullis)
Part 2
Head west towards the [[Cage (Underground path, slave)
Part 3
Go past the smashed cage and pass through the [[Tunnel (Underground Pass)
Travelling to the end of Underground Pass in Iban's lair
After entering, head as far south (past the bridges and walkways) as you can. Along the back wall, you'll find stairs.
Descend the cave stairs (this will take you to "Beneath Iban's Lair" as shown on the world map).
If you need food, talk to Kamen the dwarf in the southwest corner of the cave.
Decline or accept Kamen's brew, but note that it will lower your Agility, potentially heightening your chances of falling into the abyss in the next step.
After declining or accepting, Kamen will offer to sell you food for 75 coins.
Proceed to the northwest corner until you find cave stairs that can be ascended.
Ascend the stairs.
If at any point you fall during the next steps, these stairs are where you'll go to return to Iban's Lair and try again.
Heading south, cross the third walkway.
Jump over the [[Bridge (Iban's lair)

getting_there.heading: Travelling through Underground path
getting_there.text:
To go through the path, it is recommended to have a high Agility level. A Thieving level of 50 is another advantage.

These items are needed:
• A rope (bring more if the Agility level is low)
• A shortbow (chargebow will not work)
• A few of bronze, iron, steel, mithril, adamant, rune, dragon, or dark arrows (bring a few extras should you do so; no advantage in type)
• Food to survive traps and monsters

Part 1

Checklist | * Enter the pass through the cave entrance in West Ardougne.
• Simply walk around the swamp and do not attempt to cross the bubbles in the cave.
• Talk to Koftik, and he will give you a damp cloth.
• Use it on an arrow to change it to a fire arrow.
• Light this arrow. It is possible to miss arrows in the next steps, so you may need to make more. Only make one at a time because you can not light these arrows if there is more than one in your inventory.
• Go to the north.
• Equip the bow and fire at the guide rope with the lit fire arrow, and you will automatically cross the bridge.
• Once you have crossed the bridge, you may be attacked by level 42 blessed spiders if you are under level #expr:42*2 Combat. Stay away from the small rooms to the north and south to avoid them.
• Now, go to the little chamber to the north and pick up a plank.
• Continue going south, then east.
• Use a rope on an old spike on the ground on your side next to the north gap. It is possible to fail this part and lose your rope, so bringing multiple ropes is a good precaution. If you do fall, you will have to navigate a rock maze to get out. You will end up at the beginning of the pass, and you'll have to start with firing at the guide rope again. The old spike is very small and slightly below ground level. It may be necessary to point your camera west and zoom very far in to see it.
• Continue following the path and climb over two rockslides.
• You will come to a grid of spike traps. For each person the path to cross these is different, so it is suggested that once you find your path, you write it down somewhere. You could already have figured out which path is safe for you while doing the quest Underground Pass. The area prevents you from using abilities like Surge.

Pathmap | 5 | 5 | id=Underground Pass 
• Once past the spike traps, pull the [[Lever (Underground path, portcullis)

Part 2
• Head west towards the [[Cage (Underground path, slave)

Part 3
• Go past the smashed cage and pass through the [[Tunnel (Underground Pass)

getting_there.heading: Travelling to the end of Underground Pass in Iban's lair
getting_there.text:
• After entering, head as far south (past the bridges and walkways) as you can. Along the back wall, you'll find stairs.
• Descend the cave stairs (this will take you to "Beneath Iban's Lair" as shown on the world map).
• If you need food, talk to Kamen the dwarf in the southwest corner of the cave. 
• Decline or accept Kamen's brew, but note that it will lower your Agility, potentially heightening your chances of falling into the abyss in the next step. 
• After declining or accepting, Kamen will offer to sell you food for 75 coins. 
• Proceed to the northwest corner until you find cave stairs that can be ascended.
• Ascend the stairs. 
• If at any point you fall during the next steps, these stairs are where you'll go to return to Iban's Lair and try again.
• Heading south, cross the third walkway.
• Jump over the [[Bridge (Iban's lair)

ml.text: Spectral attendants are found in the lower, middle, and upper south-west rooms of Nomad's Temple under Soul Wars, during the Nomad's Requiem quest. The attendants are aggressive and attack using melee.

place.title: Nomad's temple
place.summary: Nomad's temple is a vast, underground area under Soul Wars. The entrance to the temple can be found by investigating Nomad's tent during the Nomad's Requiem quest. The quest Nomad's Requiem largely takes place here. It is the home of Spectral attendants, Spectral cultivators, Spectral tenders, Spectral worshippers, Elemental creatures, Corruption beasts, and two of the highest-level quest monsters in the game: the Decaying avatar and Nomad himself. Once Nomad's Requiem is completed, there is no way to enter his temple again, until a brief section during Nomad's Elegy, where the player must investigate clues with Zimberfizz.

place.title: Soul Wars
place.summary:
• They will need to battle other people and monsters. Higher combat levels would be advantageous, but they are not absolutely necessary.
• Fighting the avatars and monsters is easier with higher Slayer levels; pyrefiends and jellies have Slayer requirements of 30 and 52 respectively, while higher Slayer levels can be used to kill the other team's avatar faster. map: 

The Wizards' Tower is a famous Saradominist institute of magic and runecrafting in Misthalin. The immense tower is located on a small island south of Draynor Village, connected to the mainland by an exquisite bridge.  The tower is associated with many other wizards outside the tower as well as the Wizards' Guild of Yanille, with which it has a sort of rivalry. The Wizards' Tower has two of the only known portals to the Runespan realm, home of the Runecrafting Guild. The current Wizards' Tower is sometimes known as the Second Wizards' Tower, as the First Wizards' Tower was burnt to the ground due to a magical explosion in the year 70 of the Fifth Age.

Al Kharid was built in the early Fifth Age, by settlers from outside the desert. The dominant religion of Al Kharid is the Menaphite Pantheon with most citizens worshipping Het.

place.title: Draynor Manor
place.summary: In the south-west corner of the property is a fountain, which is a plot device in the Ernest the Chicken quest. Directly to the west of the manor is a compost heap (also a plot device involved in Ernest the Chicken), and a patch of special cabbages. These cabbages are unique in that they boost Defence 1 to 2 levels temporarily. During the course of the Black Knights' Fortress quest, these cabbages are referenced by the witch brewing the "doomsday potion" (incidentally, one cannot use a cabbage from here during the quest - the game will not let players actually ruin the quest). Right next to the cabbages is an evil turnip patch, where members can grow an evil turnip for Summoning. It is the only location to have a nightshade patch, which Ayesha the farmer says is due to the grounds of the manor being "unblessed".

place.title: Marim
place.summary: Marim is a village on Ape Atoll, inhabited by various monkeys who are ruled over by King Awowogei. It is only accessible to players who have partially or fully completed the Monkey Madness quest, and most of the quest takes place there. The village is most likely named after Marimbo, the monkey god. There are various shops and stalls around the village, including one of the only two places that sell dragon scimitars, the other one being Dealga's Scimitar Emporium in Varrock. At the south of Marim is the Ape Atoll Agility Course, which can only be used in ninja monkey form.

place.title: Ogre Enclave
place.summary: The Ogre Enclave is a dungeon located in Gu'Tanoth. It requires partial completion of the Watchtower quest to enter. The entrance to the enclave is in the western part of the ogre marketplace in the centre of Gu'Tanoth. During the quest, the player must use a cave nightshade on the ogre guard to gain entry. After the quest, this is no longer required. The cave contains the crystals for the Watchtower quest.

get_inside.text: Karamja
The entrance to the tomb.

To get to the tomb, go north beyond the temple of Ah Za Rhoon. More specifically, it's southeast of the Fairy ring DKP on the east side of the river on Karamja. There will be ancient, stone doors in the ground to enter, provided a bone key is used on them after cleaning off the foliage. The key may be re-bought after the quest from Yanni Salika.

If you have access to the gnome glider network, then teleport to Al Kharid, take the glider to the Gnome Stronghold, then take the glider to "gandius" (Karamja). From there run north to reach the northern coast of Karamja.

place.title: Temple of Marimbo Dungeon
place.summary: The dungeon is composed of three distinct parts. The first area is visited during Monkey Madness, in which the player makes monkeyspeak amulets with one of the two fire pits. This area contains some Monkey Zombies and spiders. Large monkey zombies are found on the upper area, spiders are found in the lower area, and small monkey zombies are found all over the cave.

ml.name: Creature Creation
ml.text: A Spidine is a hybrid of a sardine and a Spider. Players can create spidines in Creature Creation, in the basement dungeon of the Tower of Life building once they complete the Tower of Life quest.

place.title: Creature Creation
place.summary: Creature Creation allows players to make unique monsters, which can be attacked for their drops. Some of the monsters drop multiples of items that are otherwise hard to get or expensive to purchase, such as unicorn horns, which are used to make unicorn horn dust for Herblore and Unicorn stallion pouches for Summoning.

get_inside.text: Kandarin
The Tower of Life is found south of East Ardougne. It can be easily accessed using:
Using Ardougne cloak or Kandarin monastery Teleport, you can teleport to the nearby Monastery which is a short walk from the tower.
Ardougne Teleport brings you to the East Ardougne marketplace, with the tower to the south.
Fairy ring DJP brings you right next to the tower. Use of fairy rings requires partial completion of the quest A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen.
The closest bank without using teleportation is the one south of the marketplace in East Ardougne. If players can use fairy rings, then the bank in Zanaris or near TzHaar Fight Cave BLP are closer.

The Tower of Life is a tower south of Ardougne which features prominently in the Tower of Life quest. In the quest, you build several parts of the tower for the alchemists, since the builders refused to. The alchemists, who turn out to be callous and cruel, later flee the area when you cure and free their hybrid victim, the Homunculus. After the quest, you gain access to the basement dungeon, where the Homunculus now resides and where you can play Creature Creation.

Spiritual guardian.examine: The spiritual remains of a defender of the dungeons.

ml.name: Daemonheim
ml.text: Spiritual guardians are Slayer monsters within Daemonheim. They require a Slayer level of 63 to kill. They can be encountered on Furnished, Abandoned, Occult, and Warped floors, but encounters are uncommon. They are the only monster that can drop the protector's ward and guardian's ward shields. As with all slayer monsters within Daemonheim, an encounter is more likely if the party size and floor size is bigger. Contrary to popular belief, they are not affected by the shadow silk hood.

get_inside.text: Wilderness
Teleporting there by using the ring of kinship, which is received from the Dungeoneering tutor.
Teleporting to Daemonheim Dig Site by using the dig sites map located in the Archaeology Guild (with level 73 Archaeology after rescuing Skaldrun).
pic: The place where players arrive if they travel to Daemonheim by boat.

get_inside.text: Dungeoneering portal in the Tower of Voices in Prifddinas.

Taking the Fremennik ship from south-western Taverley by talking to Bryll Thoksdottir at the docks. While the Fremennik shipmaster at Daemonheim can take players back to Taverley, be careful not to click the third option or on the Fremennik ship behind him, as they will take players to the Shadow Reef, a high-level combat zone without any warning about its dangers.
Walking through the Wilderness to the east.
War's Retreat Teleport then enter the Shadow Reef boss portal.

place.title: Daemonheim
place.summary: Most of Daemonheim's history is told through the Chronicles of Bilrach, which are discovered as a player trains the Dungeoneering skill. Currently, an army of Fremenniks have set up a campsite in the area to prepare for their next expedition into the enormous labyrinths below the castle.

get_inside.text: Asgarnia
The entrance to the courtyard.
Falador lodestone - Teleports near the north gate.
Falador Teleport - Teleports to the city square near the north gate. Requires level 37 Magic Magic and an air runes, a water rune, and a law rune. Falador teleport tablet may also be used.

Teleport to South Falador - Teleports to the south gate southern entrance. Unlocked at the Livid Farm, requires level 72 Magic Magic, being on the Lunar Spellbook and two astral runes, a law rune, and two air runes.
Skills necklace - Teleports to the Mining Guild's entrance.
Boss portal (War's Retreat) or Boss portal (Max Guild) attuned to the giant mole - Teleports to the Falador Park.
Ring of respawn - Teleports to the White Knights' Castle after completion of Recruitment Drive.
Skills necklace or balloon transport system - Teleport to the Crafting Guild south-west of the city, and climb into the underwall tunnel shortcut (requires level 26 Agility Agility).

Falador can be entered through the north gate, which has a road leading to Barbarian Village, and features a variety of guards; from the underground Dwarven Mine (either from the Mining Guild or from a house in the north-eastern neighbourhood of the city); through the south gate near Port Sarim; or by Falador Teleport, a spell which requires level 37 Magic (also requiring a water rune, three air runes, and a law rune). The north and south gates are popular training spots for low level players hoping to level up on guards.

Those with level 5 Agility can also enter from the west by using the Agility shortcut on the crumbling wall on the west side of the city. Members also can enter by crawling under a hole in the southern wall or by using a grapple shortcut to climb over the northern wall.
Grappling

A hidey-hole can be built for the 2-way grapple shortcut over the northern wall located where the shortcut is indicated on the minimap. The hidey-hole is a buildable storage spot to store a crossbow and grapple and eliminates the need to carry a crossbow and grapple to use the shortcut. To construct the hidey-hole, level 29 construction is required, as well as a saw and hammer (the tool belt works), four planks, a bronze crossbow, mithril grapple, and four nails. It requires level 11 Agility, 19 Ranged, and 37 Strength to use.

Falador (IPAc-en | ' | f | æ | l | ə | d | ɔːr Respell-en | FAL-ə-dor ) is the capital of Asgarnia. It serves as the base of operations for the White Knights and Temple Knights, two Saradominist knightly organisations. It has a significant role in the mining and smithing industries, with the south-eastern section of the city being home to both the Mining Guild and the Artisans' Workshop, and a mining dungeon under the eastern half of the city. Falador's population is usually around 40,000, although it swelled to almost 80,000 during the Siege of Falador.

get_inside.text: Ancient Cavern
The entrance to Kuradal's Dungeon is a cave near Kuradal in the Ancient Cavern. She is located in the back of the dungeon, on the opposite side of the whirlpool entrance, and up the stairs.
There are four ways to get to the entrance:
Using a ferocious ring to teleport to Kuradal.
Using a Slayer cape or any of its variants to teleport to Kuradal.

Entering the Ancient Cavern via the lake above Baxtorian Falls, at the head of the River Dougne. To enter the cavern, players must jump off the dock on the north side of the lake into the whirlpool (followers such as pets or familiars cannot be out at this time). To be able to enter this way, players must have completed Barbarian Training up to the pyre ships part of barbarian Firemaking. One fast way to get to the dock is to teleport to the Barbarian Outpost using a games necklace or Barbarian Teleport (Lunar spellbook).

Use Fairy ring code BJQ to teleport to the Ancient Cavern. Partial completion of A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen is required to use the fairy rings, and the ring in the cavern must first be repaired before it can be used. This is done by using 5 bittercap mushrooms and a spade on the inner ring.

get_inside.text: Karamja
The entrance to Brimhaven Dungeon
The dungeon is located a short distance north-west of the Karamja lodestone. There are also other ways to get there, which are generally obsolete since the introduction of the lodestone:
It be reached by sailing from East Ardougne to Brimhaven, for a fee of 30 coins, 15 with Karamja gloves 1 or for free with the ring of charos.
Another sea route can be taken from Port Sarim to Musa Point, for the same price. However, it is a much longer walk to the dungeon entrance from Musa Point than from Brimhaven.
Alternatively, players can charter a ship to get to Brimhaven (e.g. the Port Sarim-Brimhaven charter ship ride costs 1,600 coins).
Teleportation is also practical:
Players with level 99 Dungeoneering can use the Dungeoneering cape's perk to teleport to the Brimhaven Dungeon resource dungeon after having accessed it first through other means.
House Teleport if the player-owned house is on Karamja or a Brimhaven tablet if the player has completed Love Story.
Teleport to the Karamja lodestone, which is located directly south-east of the dungeon.
Spirit tree if the player can plant a spirit tree behind the Brimhaven Agility Arena.
Amulet of glory to Karamja, then run west then south.
Fairy ring CKR and then north to the dungeon.
Use of Tai Bwo Wannai Teleport scrolls, a reward from Treasure Trails.

The nearest bank, although the quest Shilo Village and 10 extra coins are required, is Shilo Village bank by using Hajedy's cart. However, one would normally teleport to a bank and return via the the Karamja lodestone.

get_inside.text: Troll Country
Ghorrock can only be accessed upon reaching a certain stage of The Temple at Senntisten quest.

From the Rellekka Hunter area (fairy ring code: DKS) take the canoe (North-West from fairy ring code: DKS) to the Mahjarrat Ritual Site Cavern, then pass the ice block to the east. A heat globe is needed to pass Ice Block. You do not need a heat globe during Ritual of the Mahjarrat.

After the completion of Ritual of the Mahjarrat, players may use the Glacor Cave (fairy ring code: DKQ) to access Ghorrock instead, gaining the Stone of Jas damage boost in the process. Run north from the ring to the cavern exit, then north again across the ritual site to the tunnel into the wall that leads to Ghorrock. The north side of the tunnel is enclosed by debris and safe from iron dragons.
There are several other less-recommended ways to access this fairly isolated part of the world:
Teleport with either a Mask of Gelatin or Jellyhead, each having a limit of two teleports per day.
Use the Enchanted Lyre to teleport to Rellekka, then run north-east to the Trollweiss Hunter Area then walk north and then west to the canoe, which will take you to Ghorrock Fortress.

Use the Ardougne/Edgeville teleport lever (or walk) to level 56 wilderness. You will also need a sharp object, such as a knife to slash the web. From here run all the way west past the agility course. Requires passing through the deep Wilderness.
Ice Plateau Teleport (Lunar Spellbook). Requires passing through the Wilderness in addition to having level 89 in Magic.
Ghorrock Teleport (Ancient Spellbook). Requires passing through the Wilderness in addition to having level 96 in Magic.
Lava titan teleport to level 40 Wilderness just southeast of the fortress. Requires passing through the Wilderness.

Using the Wilderness Obelisk teleport portals to randomly travel to high level wilderness. If the hard Wilderness achievements have been completed, the player may select the destination themselves, with the level 44 wilderness destination being south-west of Ghorrock, however this requires the player to enter the Wilderness.
Started The Temple at Senntisten

place.title: Yu'biusk
place.summary: At some point, Yu'biusk was discovered by the god Bandos, who, after seeing the people of the world as savages, decided to give them civilisation as he knew it, and declare the world as his. During the God Wars, Bandos brought the various Yu'biuskian races to Gielinor to fight for and bring glory to his name. Following Bandos' banishment from Gielinor he took his anger out on the Yu'biuskian tribes. Some of these tribes he would manipulate and deceive while others just took advantage of weakened tribes and attacked them. Eventually this led to the construction of fire-raining weapons - weapons the likes no other world has seen according to Bandos. These weapons were what eventually tore Yu'biusk asunder and made it what it is today.

get_inside.text: Kandarin
The Necromancer Tower is south of East Ardougne and north-east of the Tower of Life. The tower can be easily reached by three teleport methods:
Ardougne Teleport brings the player to the East Ardougne marketplace, with the tower to the south.
Ardougne cloak 1 teleport brings the player to the Kandarin Monastery, with the tower to the east.
Fairy ring DJP brings the player right next to the tower. Use of fairy rings requires partial completion of the quest A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen.

The closest bank without using teleportation is the one south of the marketplace in East Ardougne. The map shows the shortest route between the bank and the Tower of Life, and the same route can be used for the Necromancer Tower. If players can use fairy rings, the bank in Zanaris is closer.

place.title: Troll Invasion
place.summary:
Troll Invasion is a members-only single-player Distraction and Diversion. The trolls are making a push to invade Burthorpe, and the Imperial Guard are being overwhelmed and require assistance. The trolls can be stopped through either combat or skilling.
monthly reset countdown 

Getting started

Speak to Captain Jute outside the newly constructed gatehouse north of the Warriors' Guild. He will offer you the choice of fighting the trolls or keeping the gatehouse repaired. Confirm that you've picked the one you want to do and you will start the D&D. You can start the game quickly by right-clicking and choosing either 'start-repairing' or 'start-fighting'. If you haven't yet done this D&D since the 1st of the current month, he will ask you if you're sure you've picked the right one as it resets the 1st of every month 0:00 UTC.

place.title: Astram Farm
place.summary: A tree patch is found in the southern part of the farm, which will be tended to by Alain if he receives the correct payment. A potato patch is found to the north of it, which is tended to for free by Head Farmer Jones. This is the only potato patch in the game, and can be useful for low-level farming, as Jones hands out free potato seeds. Jones also owns a Farming Shop, which sells a number of low level seeds and basic farming supplies such as compost and plant pots.

get_inside.text: South-west of Falador
There are several methods of reaching the Crafting Guild. In addition to walking to the guild, players may use the following transportation methods:
A skills necklace or modified artisan's bandana can be used to teleport to the Crafting Guild.
Teleporting to the Port Sarim lodestone and running north-west.
Teleporting to the Rimmington player-owned house portal.
Members who have unlocked the Crafting Guild hot air balloon route after completing Enlightened Journey can take a hot air balloon to just north of the Crafting Guild for a fee of two charges.
While the guild itself does not stock sheep, there is a handy flock wandering free immediately to the north, just outside the Makeover Mage's house.

All players can use the bank deposit box in the guild itself. This turns into a bank chest upon the completion of the hard Falador achievements. Players retain access to the bank chest even after their membership expires.

The farm is in some ways the crossroads of Asgarnia. It has a convenient location, near Draynor Village, Falador, Port Sarim, and Rimmington. There are several ways to reach the farm.
The fastest way is to utilise the Cabbageport function of the Explorer's ring 3 or 4, as this will teleport the user to the cabbage patch belonging to the farm.
If players have their house in Rimmington, they can teleport to house and run to the farm.
If players have a spirit tree grown in Port Sarim, they can teleport there and run north.
Using the Captain's Log to teleport to Port Sarim and go north.
Teleport to the Port Sarim lodestone and run north, or the Draynor lodestone then run west.
If a player binds their amulet of nature to a patch in the farm, it will teleport the player to the patch when the crops are diseased or fully grown. As this isn't certain, it is rarely used.
Players can charter a ship to Port Sarim and run north.
Falador farm

place.title: Falador farm
place.summary: If that isn't enough, there is also a large pasture containing several cows, which will all drop raw beef, bones, and their prized cowhides. The meat can be cooked in Falador or on a fire to be used as food, the bones buried, and the cowhides tanned and used for Crafting, or sold on the Grand Exchange to others wishing to train Crafting for a fair price. If players don't wish to cook the meat for food, they can also eat the cabbages that spawn in the patch nearby.

ml.name: Lumbridge

get_inside.text: Misthalin
To enter Lumbridge, players can use the bridge to the east of the town over the River Lum.
From the south, there is a path from Lumbridge Swamp that players can use to enter the town.
From the north, players can cross the bridge leading out from the west of the Champions' Guild and through the Mill Road Mill, heading east along the road.
Players can also, from the west, enter the town through the path leading from Draynor Village passing by the pale wisp colony.
Lumbridge lodestone
pic: The Lumbridge musician entertaining near the River Lum.

get_inside.text: Lumbridge Teleport - Unlike the lodestone, this requires level 31 Magic, a law rune, an earth rune, and three air runes but is faster and does not get interrupted by combat. Casting this spell is a medium Lumbridge achievement, Ease of Access.

Lumbridge teleport tablet - Members have the additional option of using teleport tablets to reach Lumbridge. This works similar to casting the Lumbridge Teleport spell normally but can be used when any spellbook is active and only takes up one inventory space.
Ring of respawn - Can teleport the player to the Lumbridge Castle courtyard.
Canoe - Provided the player has the Woodcutting level required, they may use the system to reach several locations, including Lumbridge.
A boat may be taken from the docks south of Taverley, which places players next to the Lumbridge Sage.

Portal Chamber - Players with at least level 50 Construction can build a Lumbridge Teleportation Portal in the Portal Chamber of their player-owned house. Building the portal requires 100 law runes, 300 air runes, and 100 earth runes.

Death - A method that requires little to no effort and no requirements, dying can send the player back to Lumbridge if they have not selected a different respawn point. Since Lumbridge is unlocked by default, this provides a way to get there with no skills or quests required. Players are, however, strongly recommended to bank any valuable items as they will only keep three (four with Protect item prayer on) items in case they do not reach their gravestone in time.

place.title: Lumbridge
place.summary: It is the first town that new players enter after completing the tutorial, and is home to various low level activities and quests. On the west side of the river the town has a general store, a fishing shop, a market with a bank and Thieving stalls as well as a smithy with a forge and an anvil and an entrance to the Thieves' Guild. The east side primarily features a large cow pen. The river itself has several Fishing spots. The southern part of the town houses a church with a graveyard and an entrance to the Lumbridge Catacombs and a passage to the Lumbridge Swamp. The city of Dorgesh-Kaan can be accessed from the castle's basement. West of the castle lies the Lumbridge forest.

Zanaris

place.title: Zanaris
place.summary: According to the co-ordinator, Zanaris is 'an extremely old place, it was here long before we fairyfolk came to live here' with many dormant magical properties, such as those of 'the ability to jump between planes using a powerful portal' that had been sealed for centuries, but the Fairy Queen harnessed the magic and used it to create the network of fairy rings, though not as powerful as the portal, the World Gate, would have been. This property of being a nexus of planes places it under threat from other realms. In the late Fifth Age, it was invaded by orks from Ork's Rift, but not without help of the malicious Fairy Mafia. Conversely, Zanaris is famous for its market, where various items from other worlds are sold, an example being a selection of dragon weapons from Freneskae supplied by the Consortium of Extra-Planar Merchandise Transferral Specialists.

ml.name: Canifis

get_inside.text: Morytania

Canifis may be accessed after completing the Priest in Peril quest or defeating the ghoul and passing through the holy barrier in the basement of Paterdomus for the first time. After doing so, players may travel to Canifis through any of the following methods:
Canifis lodestone just north-east of Canifis.
The Ancient Magicks spell Kharyrll Teleport.
Focussing one of the portals in the Portal Chamber of their house to Canifis (Kharyrll).
Fairy Ring code CKS.

After completing Ghosts Ahoy, using the ectophial to teleport to the ectofuntus. This gives a moderately-close teleport that is free and unlimited. If lost, one may obtain a replacement from Velorina.
After completing In Search of the Myreque, taking the shortcut to Mort'ton down a ladder south of the Hair of the Dog inn that leads to the north-east part of the Mort Myre Swamp.
Taking the Swamp Boat between The Hollows and Mort'ton. This cuts out around half the distance.
Using a ring of slaying to teleport to the Slayer Tower just north-west of Canifis.

ml.name: Temple Trekking
ml.text: location: Temple Trekking

get_inside.text: Temple Trekking starts at the town of Burgh de Rott by the northern gate. Start the minigame by reading the noticeboard nearby.
Burgh de Rott Ramble starts on the east side of the River Salve just outside Paterdomus. A player can start on either side.
There are several ways to reach Canifis or Burgh de Rott quickly where the minigame may be started. Some of these include:
Drakan's medallion teleport to Burgh de Rott (requires partial completion of The Branches of Darkmeyer).
Games necklace teleport to Burgh de Rott (requires completion of The Darkness of Hallowvale).
Kharyrll Teleport (requires completion of Desert Treasure and 66 Magic).

Fairy ring code CKS (requires partial completion of A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen quest and getting permission from the Fairy Godfather and at least a dramen staff if A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift and Lunar Diplomacy are not completed).
Teleport to Canifis via the Canifis lodestone and enter the long cave through the trapdoor behind the pub for exit near the rowboat to Mort'ton.
Teleport to the Slayer Tower just north of Canifis using a slayer ring.

place.title: Temple Trekking
place.summary: Temple Trekking is a minigame in which players must escort victims of vampyre rule from Burgh de Rott through Morytania to Paterdomus, which requires completion of the In Aid of the Myreque quest. On the way, the player must pass through Morytania's many dangers and obstacles, protecting the accompanying traveller until they reach the temple. The player must find a way across bogs and rivers and fight dangerous packs of monsters lurking in Morytania, some unique to this minigame.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Temple Trekking starts at the town of Burgh de Rott by the northern gate. Start the minigame by reading the noticeboard nearby.

Burgh de Rott Ramble starts on the east side of the River Salve just outside Paterdomus. A player can start on either side.

There are several ways to reach Canifis or Burgh de Rott quickly where the minigame may be started. Some of these include:
• Drakan's medallion teleport to Burgh de Rott (requires partial completion of The Branches of Darkmeyer).
• Games necklace teleport to Burgh de Rott (requires completion of The Darkness of Hallowvale). 
• Kharyrll Teleport (requires completion of Desert Treasure and 66 Magic).
• Fairy ring code CKS (requires partial completion of A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen quest and getting permission from the Fairy Godfather and at least a dramen staff if A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift and Lunar Diplomacy are not completed).
• Teleport to Canifis via the Canifis lodestone and enter the long cave through the trapdoor behind the pub for exit near the rowboat to Mort'ton.
• Teleport to the Slayer Tower just north of Canifis using a slayer ring.

get_inside.text: Pollnivneach
Using a Pollnivneach Teleport scroll is the fastest way to get there, as it puts the player very close to the entrance of the dungeon.
Using a ring of slaying to teleport to Sumona, although this requires completion of Smoking Kills. (Players with the Slayer cape can also use its perk to teleport to Sumona.)
Use the Desert amulet 2 or higher to teleport to Nardah, then take the magic carpet to Pollnivneach.
If a player's house is in Pollnivneach, they can teleport to their house. If the player has completed Love Story, a Pollnivneach tablet can be used regardless of the player's house location.
Using the magic carpets, players can pay a fee (or ride freely using the ring of charos) to Pollnivneach.
From the Bandit Camp's lodestone, walk east to Pollnivneach, or take the shortcut in the Smoke Dungeon.

place.summary: The dungeon can be entered by climbing down a well in the centre of Pollnivneach. Unlike the Morytania Slayer Tower and Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, a dwarf multicannon can be used in this dungeon.

ml.name: Creature Creation
ml.text: A swordchick is a hybrid of a chicken and a swordfish. Players can create swordchicks in Creature Creation, in the basement dungeon of the Tower of Life building once they complete the Tower of Life quest.

place.title: Creature Creation
place.summary: Creature Creation allows players to make unique monsters, which can be attacked for their drops. Some of the monsters drop multiples of items that are otherwise hard to get or expensive to purchase, such as unicorn horns, which are used to make unicorn horn dust for Herblore and Unicorn stallion pouches for Summoning.

get_inside.text: Kandarin
The Tower of Life is found south of East Ardougne. It can be easily accessed using:
Using Ardougne cloak or Kandarin monastery Teleport, you can teleport to the nearby Monastery which is a short walk from the tower.
Ardougne Teleport brings you to the East Ardougne marketplace, with the tower to the south.
Fairy ring DJP brings you right next to the tower. Use of fairy rings requires partial completion of the quest A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen.
The closest bank without using teleportation is the one south of the marketplace in East Ardougne. If players can use fairy rings, then the bank in Zanaris or near TzHaar Fight Cave BLP are closer.

The Tower of Life is a tower south of Ardougne which features prominently in the Tower of Life quest. In the quest, you build several parts of the tower for the alchemists, since the builders refused to. The alchemists, who turn out to be callous and cruel, later flee the area when you cure and free their hybrid victim, the Homunculus. After the quest, you gain access to the basement dungeon, where the Homunculus now resides and where you can play Creature Creation.
